payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the G-SAT model consistently outperforms existing systems in terms of accuracy across multiple languages and conditions.

claims.text: The G-SAT model outperforms both GLAD and GCE on the joint goal metric across three languages of the WOZ2.0 dataset.
G-SAT achieves higher accuracy than GLAD and GCE even when using the same embedding size, demonstrating its superior performance.
The G-SAT model is reported to provide competitive advantages over state-of-the-art DST systems in terms of accuracy and time complexity.
